statements.chinese: 也许我该和Monica一起！

statements.english: No , it's too soon for you guys
statements.chinese: 不，对你们来说还太早了。

statements.english: Yeah , you're right about that
statements.chinese: 是啊，这点你说得对。

statements.english: ... now when they found the remains of the Mesozoic Mastodon
statements.chinese: ……如今当他们发现了中生代乳齿象的遗骸

statements.english: they discovered what appeared to be the remains
statements.chinese: 他们发现了看似是遗骸的东西

statements.english: of a Paleozoic Amphibian in its jaws !
statements.chinese: 一条古生代两栖动物在其颌中！

statements.english: How did it get there ?!
statements.chinese: 它是怎么到那儿的？！

did.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句

statements.english: Maybe this should be more of a quiet game
statements.chinese: 或许这应该是个更安静的游戏。

statements.english: Hey guys !
statements.chinese: 大家好！

statements.english: Hi !
statements.chinese: 你好！

statements.english: Joey , I left my watch on the counter last night
statements.chinese: Joey，昨晚我把手表落在柜台上了。

statements.english: It was right here , where is it ?
statements.chinese: 它刚才还在这里，现在去哪儿了？

statements.english: I don't know
statements.chinese: 我不知道。

statements.english: All right , come on , I'm-I'm late for work !
statements.chinese: 好了，快点，我上班要迟到了！

statements.english: How do you know ? You don't have a watch
statements.chinese: 你怎么知道？你又没有手表。

statements.english: Guys , could you please just stop throwing the ball for one minute
statements.chinese: 各位，能不能麻烦你们暂停一分钟别扔球了

statements.english: and just help me find it !
statements.chinese: 快帮我找到它！

statements.english: Oh , I don't know .... Yeah , can't do it
statements.chinese: 呃，我不太确定……嗯，办不到。

statements.english: What ?!
statements.chinese: 什么？！

statements.english: Monica , whatever you do , do not drop that ball !
statements.chinese: Monica，无论如何你都不能失手！

statements.english: Yeah , we haven't dropped it in ..
statements.chinese: 是啊，我们还没把它放进去...

statements.english: 2 hours , 27 minutes
statements.chinese: 2小时27分钟

statements.english: Really ?!
statements.chinese: 真的吗？！

statements.english: I-I'm not gonna be able to make it into work today
statements.chinese: 我-我今天没法去上班了,

statements.english: I don't feel very good
statements.chinese: 我感觉不太舒服。

statements.english: Yes !!
statements.chinese: 太好了！！

statements.english: Wow ! Uh , for a second there
statements.chinese: 哇！呃，刚才那一瞬间

statements.english: I thought I was really better , but I'm not
statements.chinese: 我以为我真的好起来了，但其实并没有。

was.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去进行时

statements.english: Hey Rach !
statements.chinese: 嘿，Rach！

statements.english: Check it out ! Almost 3 hours without droppin ' it !
statements.chinese: 快来看！将近3个小时都没掉下来！

statements.english: Oh , wow ! Congratulations , that's quite a waste of time
statements.chinese: 哦，哇！恭喜啊，这可真是浪费时间。

statements.english: - Rach ? - Yeah ?
statements.chinese: - Rach？ - 在呢？

statements.english: You have scratches all over you , what happened ?
statements.chinese: 你浑身都是擦伤，发生什么事了？

statements.english: Well , it's my cat
statements.chinese: 嗯，这是我的猫。

statements.english: What ?!
statements.chinese: 什么？！

statements.english: Oh yeah , I got a cat
statements.chinese: 哦对了，我养了只猫。

statements.english: I don't want a cat !
statements.chinese: 我不想要猫！

statements.english: Oh , don't worry , it's not a cat
statements.chinese: 哦，别担心，不是猫。

statements.english: Yeah
statements.chinese: 是啊。

statements.english: You guys this cat is nothing like my grandmother's cat
statements.chinese: 各位，这只猫跟我奶奶养的猫完全不一样。

is.definition: be（第三人称单数现在时）: 是

statements.english: I mean , it's not sweet , it's not cute
statements.chinese: 我是说，这既不甜美，也不可爱,
